narrative: The Theatre yard at dusk, from the tiring-house, after the doors have opened. Backs of cloaks moving toward the lane. A torch just lit by the stage-door post, smoking in grey air. Nutshells and mud. No moon. No one turned around. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once, and did not follow.
